label: Tab system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism or resident prophage possesses a Tab virion-assembly-inhibition locus that expresses the Tab tail-assembly-blocking protein, blocks assembly of invading phage tails, prevents infectious virion formation, and protects the bacterial community from phage spread.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual tab genes, Tab proteins, the Tab counter-defence protein, phage tail proteins, phage virion assembly as a biological process, individual Pseudomonas prophages, source database rows naming one Tab system, DefenseFinder HMM or rule rows absent from the pinned model files, and other phage-defense systems.
